tokens.name: bg
tokens.usage: Page, poster and post ground. Dark is the default for every digital asset; light is for print, daylight standees and documents.

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Cards and panels sitting on `bg`.

tokens.name: surface-raised
tokens.usage: Secondary buttons, quiet chips, icon buttons.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: 1px card borders and dividers. Decorative only, never the only thing separating controls.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: All text on `bg`, `surface` and `surface-raised` (17.7:1 dark, 16.7:1 light).

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Meta lines, captions, legal lines on `bg` and `surface` (7.0:1 / 6.4:1 dark, 5.4:1 / 6.0:1 light).

tokens.name: lime
tokens.usage: THE brand colour. The wordmark’s 3, primary CTA fills, sticker fills, big colour blocks. On dark it can be text (16.8:1 on `bg`); on light it is a FILL ONLY (1.0:1 as text on light `bg`).

tokens.name: on-lime
tokens.usage: Text and icons on a `lime` fill, both themes (16.8:1 / 14.6:1). Never white on lime.

tokens.name: violet
tokens.usage: Second brand colour: the hard sticker shadow, anonymous identity, The Hustle side of the app. Text on `bg` in both themes (8.5:1 dark, 5.0:1 light).

tokens.name: on-violet
tokens.usage: Text on a `violet` fill (8.5:1 dark).

tokens.name: anon-tile
tokens.usage: Background of the anonymous mask tile and the Anonymous chip; same in both themes, always paired with `anon-ink`.

tokens.name: anon-ink
tokens.usage: Text and mask icon on `anon-tile` (8.9:1).

tokens.name: hot
tokens.usage: Signal pink: “new”, “live”, urgent, unread. At most one hot element per asset. Light value is 4.1:1 on light `bg`: use it as a fill or for text 24px+ only.

tokens.name: success
tokens.usage: Verified, paid, approved. Always with a word or ✓. Light value is 3.9:1 on light `bg`: fills or 24px+ text only.

tokens.name: warning
tokens.usage: Pending, deadlines. Always with a word. Light value is 3.8:1 on light `bg`: fills or 24px+ text only.

tokens.name: error
tokens.usage: Errors and removals only, never in marketing headlines (6.5:1 dark, 5.0:1 light).

tokens.name: info
tokens.usage: Club and category tints in the app; in marketing only as a photo-adjacent accent on dark.

tokens.name: mod-tile
tokens.usage: Campus Mod badge and safety callouts background.

tokens.name: mod-ink
tokens.usage: Text on `mod-tile`.

tokens.name: focus-ring
tokens.usage: 2px solid keyboard focus ring with a 2px `bg` gap, on web pages and landing pages.

styles.name: mega
styles.usage: Posters and standees, 2–3 words. One per asset.

styles.name: section
styles.usage: Section titles, card titles in marketing layouts.

styles.name: number
styles.usage: Big real numbers: prices, dates, counts.

styles.name: lead
styles.sample: Verified students only. Your college, your people, your hustle.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: Notes, PYQs, events, clubs and paid gigs — all on one campus app.
styles.usage: Running text in posts, decks, web.

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Eyebrows and badges. The only place for all caps.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Icon-to-label gaps.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Chip gaps, sticker inner padding (vertical).

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Card inner gaps.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Phone gutter; card padding.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Gaps between blocks on posts and slides.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Section gaps on web.

tokens.name: space-12
tokens.usage: Poster margins at 1080 wide.

tokens.name: space-16
tokens.usage: Story safe-zone side margin at 1080 wide; landing hero padding.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Small badges, swatches.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Buttons and inputs.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Cards, chips, stickers.

tokens.name: radius-xl
tokens.usage: Hero cards, photo frames on posters, app icon at 120px.

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Pill stickers and tags.

tokens.name: shadow-sticker
tokens.usage: The one hard violet offset under the main action or hero sticker. Never blurred, never more than one per asset.

tokens.name: shadow-sticker-lg
tokens.usage: The same shadow at poster scale (1080px+ wide).

tokens.name: tilt-left
tokens.usage: Default sticker and avatar tilt.

tokens.name: tilt-right
tokens.usage: Second sticker in a pair, so two stickers never lean the same way.

tokens.name: tilt-max
tokens.usage: Upper limit. Wordmark and body text are never tilted.
